summary: Iteration 3 fully verified end-to-end. All 13 new backend tests pass in ~13s covering: version=1.2.0, Whisper /api/transcribe with real WAV fixture returning {text, language} shape + 400 on >25MB payload, weights_override actually merges over defaults and steers routing (cost=0.8 -> Gemini 3 Flash for text prompts), stream meta event carries merged weights, image_generation persistence roundtrip (Nano Banana produced real image bytes, GET /api/sessions/{id}/messages returns full data_url >867KB base64, has_images=true, num_images=1), and intent bug fix: 'genera immagine minimalista di una foglia' -> image_generation (multi-word phrase 'genera immagine' outweighs single-word 'immagine'). Regression tests: /orchestrate 400, /sessions, /models=5, /compare all still pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright: nav-settings routes to settings-view with 4 sliders + save/reset; save-weights-btn normalizes to sum=1 and persists to localStorage key ai4life_weights_v1; reset-weights-btn clears the key. Style Presets chips visible above PromptDock, clicking style-cyberpunk toggles active state and persists to ai4life_active_styles_v1. Only ONE voice-btn instance in the DOM (earlier duplicate bug is fixed). Voice recording pipeline verified end-to-end: clicked voice-btn (mic permission granted, fake device engaged), toggled state to recording, second click stopped and Whisper transcribed the fake audio back into the prompt input with a 'Trascritto' toast. When user submits from chat, weights_override={'cost':0.8,...} is included in the request body and Stile prefix is prepended to the prompt (verified via request interception); the routing metadata badge shows 'Gemini 3 Flash' as expected. Session with images was reloaded from the sidebar and data-testid='generated-image-0' rendered the cat image using the persisted data URL. Submitting with no styles selected does not crash.

minor.issue: 1.5s 440Hz tone WAV is transcribed to a promotional string 'Sottotitoli creati dalla comunità Amara.org' by Whisper (a known Whisper hallucination on near-silent audio). Not a backend defect, just noting for test-authoring context.

issues: React logs a hydration warning: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. In SessionsPanel.jsx line ~74 the small 'delete' button is nested inside the outer session button. Restructure to use a <div role=button> for the outer surface or move the delete control out of the button element to remove the console error.

Same for backend_test.py::test_orchestrate_image_generation_placeholder which still asserts 'Modello selezionato' string, but the product now actually renders images and returns 'Immagine generata.'. critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/transcribe: temp file is written before size check. The 25MB guard is applied after `content = await audio.read()`, so an arbitrarily large body is fully buffered in memory before the check fires. Prefer checking `audio.size` if provided by the client OR stream-read in chunks and short-circuit when the cap is exceeded, to avoid OOM on abusive uploads.

server.py /api/transcribe: on the 400 branch (>25MB) the temp file has already been created via NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) but the `finally` cleanup only fires because tmp_path is bound; however the HTTPException is raised inside the `with` block before tmp.write completes for large payload — verify tmp_path is unlinked on 400. Safer: assign tmp_path outside the with, and unlink in a try/finally that also covers the 400 path.

history.py.save_turn stores full base64 data_urls inline. A 1MP JPEG is ~600-900KB base64, and Mongo doc limit is 16MB — 20+ image turns in one document could still be safe, but the sessions.turn_count now silently rolls up potentially 10-30MB of image payload across a session. Consider moving images to GridFS or a separate images collection referenced by id when num_images grows.

services/history.py still opens its own AsyncIOMotorClient at import time separate from server.py's client — carried over from iteration 2. Consolidate into a single client to avoid duplicate connection pools.
orchestrate_stream persists AFTER emitting done in iter 2 comment was addressed (now yields done AFTER save_turn) — good.
SessionsPanel.jsx renders a delete <button> inside the outer session <button>, producing a React hydration warning. Nested interactive controls also break some assistive tech.

Settings.jsx: after clicking Reset, resetWeights() removes the key from localStorage but the state is set from DEFAULT_WEIGHTS in-memory; if user then submits a request without re-saving, Dashboard's getWeights() will re-read DEFAULT_WEIGHTS (fine). But if user drags sliders and hits Reset, unsaved changes are still cleared silently — consider a confirmation.

VoiceButton.jsx catches getUserMedia errors with a toast, but does not handle the case where MediaRecorder is unsupported (older Safari) — it will throw TypeError from `new MediaRecorder(...)` before the try/catch of getUserMedia captures it (actually inside try, so it'll toast fine, but message is 'MediaRecorder is not defined'). Add capability sniffing.

StylePresets.applyStyleModifiers mutates the prompt with a bracketed prefix '[Stile: ...]\n\n<prompt>'. This is fine for text intents but for image_generation it becomes part of the prompt sent to Nano Banana — which is desirable, but note the router still sees the same intent because 'genera immagine' still triggers image_generation. Consider deduping if user's prompt already starts with '[Stile:'.

Dashboard.jsx: getWeights() is called only inside handleSubmit; a user could open Settings, save new weights, and if the Dashboard component was unmounted for a moment (React 18 strict-mode double-mount in dev) the read is fresh — good. No stale closure.
